tags.description: White marble shark sculpture ("The Shark", 2000) by sculptor Kemal Tufan at ~8m depth off Guvercin Ada (Pigeon Island), Kas. Site also has an old wooden wreck at ~22m and a sheet-metal artificial-reef wreck at ~28m, plus scattered ancient amphorae.
tags.name: Shark Sculpture
Uçak Batığı
tags.historic_period: aircraft type dates to WWII; this airframe served with the Turkish Air Force before decommissioning and scuttling in 2008
tags.description: Ex-Turkish Air Force Douglas C-47A Dakota (~19.6m long, ~29m wingspan, twin Pratt & Whitney R-1830 engines), deliberately scuttled by BOSAD as an artificial reef at Karaada/Pacoz Cove near Bodrum on 1 July 2008 (one source states 2007). A 2010 storm broke the fuselage apart; engine/cockpit sections now sit at 16-23m while the detached fuselage/tail rest at 28-36m. NOT the Savoia-Marchetti SM.79 previously listed here - that was an unverified/incorrect identification and has been corrected.

tags.name: Büyük Resif
tags.description: Big Reef between Bodrum Peninsula and Karaada (Black Island), opposite St. Peter's Castle. Karaada-facing wall drops from ~7m to 34m; Gumbet-facing side descends in terraces. Strong currents; multiple dive-shop sources recommend advanced/experienced divers.

tags.name: Aksona
tags.description: Aksona Point/Bay, ~50 min by boat beyond Karaada near Bodrum, named for sponge hunter Aksona Mehmet. Dive starts at 3m, slopes through the 20s to a rock wall at 30-35m. Phoenician ship anchor at 13.5m on a flat rock plus scattered amphorae/pottery. Corrected depth from 45m (unsupported) to 35m per 3 independent sources.
